name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Brendan Boyle running with large financial advantage ($5.6M on hand)
No polling or expert ratings; Polymarket prices Boyle near 97%
model.rationale: Boyle is a well-funded incumbent in a D+19 Philadelphia district, and prediction markets price his win at roughly 97%, consistent with the fundamentals. With no competitive polling or outside spending against him, there is no evidence to move off the baseline.
model.watch: A surprise primary loss or unexpected redistricting change would be the main way this race becomes competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle, the Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored to win a sixth term in this Philadelphia-based district, which leans Democratic by about 19 points. He has raised $2.45 million and holds $5.6 million on hand, while Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has reported minimal fundraising activity. No outside groups are spending against Boyle.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the financial gap. Prediction markets price Boyle's chances near 97 percent. The expected margin is about 25 points, with the seat rated Safe Democratic.
